cc:Work.dc:description:
Stackable bin base on bintray
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes StackableBin --sx '50*2' --h 60 --d 90 --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes StackableBin --sx --h --d --reference
